newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Energy Systems IPO shares increased.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Energy Systems IPO shares increased.

text.p: Shares of the initial public offering of US Energy Systems Inc were increased to 3.1 million from 1.6 million, lead underwriter for the deal, Gaines Berland Inc, said Wednesday.
A representative of the syndicate department of Gaines Berland said that the IPO is still expected to price at $4.10 a share.
She added that the IPO is expected to make its market debut in early November.
U.S. Energy Systems Inc is an independent power producer located in West Palm Beach, Florida.
